training_boundary.scope: Full-state engineering boundary only; no quality claim or continuation.

source_sensitivity.limits: Source-ID sensitivity on existing development scores, not fresh inference or a new scene-independent test. Fixed cohorts selected from content/metadata after historical4k review but before original20k full427 scoring. Unknown aliases, ancestor-model/foundation pretraining exposure and training/selection uncertainty remain unmeasured. Classical bounds/observation metadata and all original427 results are retained. No quality promotion or native-pixel review is supplied by these statistics.

hue_limitations: One observation per grid cell, one WB/camera, three brightnesses/two saturations; scene-linear HSV, not perceptually uniform. Clean targets stay below white; noisy ADC can clip. Descriptive quantiles are not confidence intervals. Not training-repeat uncertainty, real-photo quality, convergence, cause or SOTA evidence.

numerical_criteria.manual_native_color_detail_highlight_rev: required; not evaluated by this tool
numerical_criteria.limits: Threshold application only, using the separate primary coverage/arithmetic review. Does not recompute predictions, metrics or bootstrap intervals. Source/scene intervals do not estimate training-seed uncertainty. Canonical camera-linear scores retain the original target convention. Numerical passes alone cannot authorize full-frame integration, promotion or establish SOTA/100MP10s.

weak_texture_hypothesis.scope: Two predeclared carrier/flat contrasts after full1344-case scalar coverage/arithmetic audit. Signed coherent gain and unrelated error remain separate. Descriptive analytic means are not photographic or training-seed uncertainty; manual native review remains required.

notes_by_panel.full427: All current arms, V63 and V43 suppress noise and preserve broad canopy/building geometry. Fine paraglider cords visible in exact GT remain largely absent in all methods; cloud wisps/edge texture are softened. No clear visible bank-context advantage in these two fixed RGB8 examples. RawNIND is not present on this photo board; its numerical comparison and actual camera/GFX boards are separate.
notes_by_panel.known: Current arms and parent are close; low-contrast plate variation is smoothed, pale zigzag retained. Isolated bright chart point remains. RawNIND shows softer/fringed chart borders and less distinct zigzag; V43 is visually close to the current arms. Auxiliary AHD is not exact RGB GT.
notes_by_panel.unseen: Current arms, parent and V43 are visually close in the two mostly smooth/broad warm-colored ROIs. RawNIND softens the illustrated boundaries further. These crops give limited thin-structure evidence; AHD grain/pattern is not exact RGB GT.
notes_by_panel.gfx: Sky noise is strongly reduced by all methods. Current arms, V63 and V43 show similar building/leaf/fence geometry. Their fence diamonds remain more continuous than the broken/checkered RawNIND pattern; RawNIND building/leaf boundaries also look less clean. Foliage and fine detail remain soft compared with independent ISO100, whose aperture/exposure/motion differ. No clear bank-only advantage or new failure in these fixed four regions.
notes_by_panel.analytic: The dark period8 carrier is nearly absent in both current arms; the bright period16 carrier is only weakly retained compared with exact GT. No obvious new coherent banding appears in the matched flat tile. This agrees with failed signed-gain gates and passed flat-RMS ceilings.
notes_by_panel.hue: Gray flat remains clean. Bright saturated orange/magenta fields show less broad mottling in both new arms than in V63. Bank/control are visually close; complete metrics include hue/bias tradeoffs rather than universal improvement.
notes_by_panel.highlights: Fine cyan/blue neon-wave detail in independent ISO100 remains missing or strongly attenuated in all three predictions. Broad sign/platform geometry is similar across the current arms and parent; no obvious new bank-specific color fringe is seen in these fixed views. ISO100 AHD is not exact GT.
notes_by_panel.hue-extra: All four fixed lower-saturation/darker orange/magenta palettes were inspected as native cells. Parent pastel/deep-magenta mottling is reduced in both current arms; the bank/control display difference is small. These flat cases do not establish weak-texture recovery.

reasons: Both arms fail the predeclared known4/unseen5 measured-CFA improvements versus the genuine parent.
Both fixed weak-carrier signed-gain improvement gates fail, despite passed flat-RMS ceilings.
Native cords and neon-wave detail remain unresolved; no broad real quality or SOTA claim follows.

manual_review.limits: Fixed native preview cases only, RGB8 at original scale; complete FP32 numerical audits are separate. Independent real AHD/ISO100 references are not exact GT. One training seed, source/scene intervals do not estimate seed uncertainty. No protected-final score, new full-frame run, new16bit export or speed measurement.
manual_review.scope: Actual viewing of all eight completed final boards and every one of their125 unchanged native160px cells, including V43/RawNIND where available and four extra hue palettes. No inference, resampling, threshold change, source/ROI selection, training extension or promotion.
